utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing—just tell me what’s been gathered so far, and I’ll keep track.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect—I’ll keep the list updated, and I’ll let you know about the start time as soon as I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, it’s shaping up nicely—folks have been bringing in all sorts of things, and I’ll keep passing along whatever I hear.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Tess — if you hear the exact start time and meeting spot, could you let me know? I’m happy to bring whatever’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn — I’d appreciate the details. Let me know where they set it up, and I’ll keep an eye out too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll swing by with the details and let you know where they set it up.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’m still watching for the exact spot, and I’ll send the time and place as soon as I know.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Leo — I’ll wait for the final time and place, then I’ll help share the repair drive details right away.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What’s been gathered so far for the repair drive, and do you have the start time yet?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m still watching for the exact setup spot, and I don’t have the start time yet. I’ll let you know as soon as I find it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still waiting on the exact location and time for the repair drive, but I’ll let you know as soon as I have it. Once I do, I can tell you whether you need to bring anything.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Okay, just ping me when you’ve got the time and spot. I can bring gloves or tape if needed.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’ll keep an eye out for where they set up the repair drive and let you know the exact spot.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Jules — I appreciate it. Once you know the exact spot, send it my way and I’ll pass it along to everyone.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks—I might need those details. I’ve been a bit out of it lately, so please pass them along if you can.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Of course—I can share the details and keep you updated on the repair drive. Just tell me what you need and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, I can borrow the tools for the repair drive if I need them, right?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, absolutely — you can borrow the tools if you need them. I’m still double-checking the repair drive details, so I’ll confirm the exact spot and start time as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Could you start with the repair drive details? Just the first item is enough, thanks.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — if you need tools for the repair drive, I’ve got a few you can borrow. Just let me know what you’re fixing.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help — if you’ve got a repair list, I can take the job that needs the most hands.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Sam. I’ll check the repair list and let you know which job needs the most hands.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still only hearing bits second-hand, but it sounds like the repair drive is coming up soon and staying pretty low-key. What’s the latest you’ve heard?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yep, that’s still the plan — it’s coming along quietly, and I’ll let everyone know the start time once it’s set.
